# Churchill Downs News Release: $42,254 Late Pick 5 Carryover Saturday at Churchill Downs


## Nov 20, 2026


Horseplayers will have a $42,254 carryover in Saturday’s 50-cent Late Pick 5 at Churchill Downs after no tickets had all five winners in Friday’s middle sequence.


First post for Saturday’s 11-race card is 1 p.m. (all times Eastern), with the Late Pick 5 beginning in Race 7 at 3:55 p.m.


Saturday’s Late Pick 5 sequence:


Race 7 (3:55 p.m.) – Alw 127000n2x, 3&up, 1 1/8 M (T) (12 entries)
Race 8 (4:25 p.m.) – MC 150000, 2yo, 1 M (nine entries)
Race 9 (4:55 p.m.) – OC 80000n3x, f&m, 3&up, 6 ½ F (nine entries)
Race 10 (5:25 p.m.) – $300,000 Commonwealth Turf (Grade III), 3yo, 1 1/16 M (T) (nine entries)
Race 11 (5:55 p.m.) – Mdn 120k, 2yo, 6 ½ F (12 entries)
Friday’s mid-Pick 5 carryover occurred partially due to Impavido’s 34-1 upset in Race 5 where he returned $71.66. The sequence concluded in Race 7 where Tiger Baby ($16.44) upset heavy 6-5 favorite Maranello.


The Pick 5 has a 50-cent minimum and a 15 percent takeout.


Fans can watch and wager on all the action from Churchill Downs at www.TwinSpires.com, the official wagering platform of Churchill Downs Incorporated.


For more information about the Churchill Downs Fall Meet, visit www.ChurchillDowns.com.
